descriptor._caption: Follow the community far enough and you can see where it is headed: a place where building the good future is a neighborhood activity. Warm, quiet, unsteered by any one hand, held up by everyone in it.

prompt: Picture-book spread painted in the warm editorial ink-and-wash register of the FIRST reference image. THE FIRST REFERENCE IMAGE IS A STYLE ANCHOR ONLY. Match it for MEDIUM, BRUSHWORK, PALETTE and LIGHT QUALITY ONLY, and take NO subject from it whatsoever: none of its objects, figures, costume, props, furniture, architecture, period or location may appear in the output unless the scene description below asks for them by name. SCENE: THE FLOATING SETTLEMENT is the subject, exactly as the establishing plate composes it: the teardrop rock below, terraces and spires above, floating free and unsteered in warm open sky, no chains, no pillars, no engines. Render it at golden hour, small warm lights beginning to show on the terraces, two or three tiny winged block-towers circling far above it like distant birds. Below and around it, open sky and soft cloud. Keep the silhouette exactly the plate's silhouette. The lower right quarter stays calm open sky. THE CAMERA MOVES; NOTHING ELSE DOES. Every person keeps the exact seat, side and place the setting's blocking gives them, and if a BLOCKING PLATE is supplied it is the authority on who sits where: obey it at every distance. Whatever the subject is sitting at, leaning on or standing beside is STILL IN THIS PICTURE, in the near foreground if the camera is close. Everyone else present in this place is STILL PRESENT in the picture, behind or beside the subject, soft and out of focus if they are not the subject, and NOBODY leaves and NO seat empties because the camera came closer. FRAMING, WIDE: the camera is well back and the PLACE is the subject. Any figures sit inside the space at full length and no taller than half the frame, so the room, its geometry and its light all read at once. founder-paradise exactly as its reference plate: A floating protopian island in open sky above the jungle. Underneath, a gentle teardrop of pale rock trailing thin skirts of mist. On top, terraced gardens stepping up from the rim, low cream buildings with warm windows, slender brass wind-spires, small orchards and pools. It floats free: no chains, no pillars, no engines. Two fixed camera angles: ESTABLISHING (from below, over the jungle canopy) and TERRACE (standing on a rim garden terrace looking along the edge, jungle far below like a green sea). From below, the island sits high in the frame with canopy or clearing in the lower third; it is never close enough to read individual doors. On the terrace, the rim rail and the drop beyond it carry the height; buildings stay low and behind, sky stays generous. Pale terraced stone, green gardens, low cream buildings with warm windows, brass wind-spires, soft banners without lettering, drifting small clouds. Futuristic reads as graceful and quiet, never chrome, never neon, never engines or thrusters. The island reads about the size of a small hill town: whole gardens and rooftops are visible at once from below, and birds passing near it read as specks. From the terrace, the jungle below reads as a soft green sea with no individual trees. THERE ARE NO PEOPLE AND NO CHARACTERS OF ANY KIND IN THIS IMAGE. No person, no figure, no head, no shoulder, no arm, no hand, no silhouette, no reflection of a person, and nobody seated in any chair. Any place a figure might be expected is empty. NEGATIVES: neon, 3D/CGI/Pixar, glossy plastic, HUD/arc-reactor comic vocabulary, neo-comic. ONE SINGLE CONTINUOUS FULL-BLEED PAINTING that fills the entire canvas edge to edge. This is NEVER a grid, NEVER a multi-panel layout, NEVER a comic page, NEVER a contact sheet, NEVER a study or turnaround sheet, NEVER a collage, and NEVER several framed views side by side. Some reference images supplied to you are multi-panel study sheets; use them ONLY for the identity and design of what they depict, and NEVER copy their panelled layout into the output. The output has exactly ONE camera, ONE moment, and NO internal borders, frames, gutters, or dividing lines of any kind.
